Laser versus scalpel

      FAQ

      Good questions

      How it works

      Light that cuts and seals

      A focused beam

      A concentrated beam of light vaporises tissue along a very fine line.

      Sealed as it goes

      Small blood vessels and nerve endings close up behind the beam.

      Gentler healing

      Less trauma to surrounding tissue usually means less swelling.
